svg.title: Optimisers in a narrow valley: plain SGD zigzags across it, momentum adds up the push along it, and Adam sizes each parameter's step on its own
svg.text: 03.02's valley, (w0^2 + 50 w1^2) / 2, from (-4, 1), to a loss below 1e-4
v = mu * v + g; w -= lr * v
m, v: running means of g and g^2,
first, then Adam's step on g alone
03.05's rate: 200 steps of warmup, cosine decay
Steep across, shallow along: a step small enough for the steep way crawls along the shallow way.
Each optimiser is the fix for what you watched the one before it do. (Paths computed here.)
